{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor packets''' contained all the data collected by an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] during a mission. Afterwards, the sensor packet was downloaded into a wide screen [[holoviewer]] for an accurate recount of the pilot's performance. Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] preferred verbal descriptions of their flying because it included how they felt about their performance.
